call_points.text: Guided for at least 50% PAT growth in FY27 over FY26 supported by higher-margin revenue recognition.
Maintained net cash position of ₹322 Cr as of Q2 end with borrowing cost at 7.75%.
Acquired fire and safety business of SOBHA Projects and Trade Limited to handle execution in-house.
FY27 completions guided at 6-6.5 msf versus 5.4 msf last year, about 20% higher.
EBITDA margin at 9.7% in Q1; Q2 similar, then improving towards 17-20% by Q4 as high-margin projects complete.
Collections lagged pre-sales as new sales came late in the quarter and April-May labour shortage delayed milestone billing.
Sobha Rivana in Noida has been steady post-launch, without a high initial sell-through.
call_points.versus_prior: addresses the earlier concern on softer initial Rivana sales

guidance.statement: We expect to grow at a similar rate as last year, about 30% growth in terms of sales in FY27.

status_history.evidence: Q1FY27 pre-sales of ₹3,656 Cr, up 76% YoY; management reiterated at least 30% FY27 growth.

guidance.statement: At least 30% growth in pre-sales for FY27, possibly slightly better if launches happen on time.
Complete 6-6.5 million sq ft in FY27 versus 5.4 million sq ft last year.
EBITDA margin to improve sequentially to 17-20% by Q4FY27 from 9.7% in Q1.
Net debt to be at about zero for FY27.
Land investment of ₹1,500-1,600 Cr in FY27 if identified transactions complete.
we should be able to deliver at least over 50% growth of PAT over last financial year, by the end of this financial year.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Realty > Residential, Commercial Projects

operating_notes.text: FY26 real estate sales reached an all-time high of ₹8,136 Cr with average price realization of ₹14,675 per sq ft.
Q1FY27 pre-sales of ₹3,656 Cr across 2.34 msf and 1,432 homes at an average realisation of ₹15,655 per sq ft.
Unsold inventory of 14.94 msf at end-Q1FY27; forthcoming launch pipeline of 20.77 msf across 17 projects.
₹20,553 Cr of revenue yet to be recognised from sales already done; projected receivable from sale and unsold value ₹31,000 Cr against ₹19,000 Cr remaining cost.
Q2FY27 average price realisation was ₹15,522 per sq ft.
H1FY27 launched 7.92 msf across five projects in Bangalore, Gurgaon and Calicut with estimated sale potential of ₹11,200 Cr.
Net debt-to-equity ratio reported at -0.07 at end-Q2FY27.
Acquired fire and safety business of SOBHA Projects and Trade Limited with an order book of ₹180 Cr.
Total revenue yet to be recognized from sold units stands at ₹22,040 Cr.

timeline.summary: 2026-04-30: Sobha Limited schedules Q4FY26 results conference call for May 5, 2026.
Sobha Limited reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹1,984.71 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹6 per share.
2026-05-04: Sobha Limited filed statement of deviation in utilisation of ₹1,999 Cr rights issue proceeds
2026-05-09: Sobha Limited uploaded the transcript of the Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call held on May 5, 2026.
Promoter **Ravi PNC Menon** confirmed unchanged shareholding (52.88%) and nil encumbrances for Sobha Limited as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
2026-07-27: Sobha uploaded the Q1FY27 earnings call transcript, reporting record quarterly pre-sales of ₹3,656 Cr (+76% YoY) and PAT of ₹50.7 Cr.
Sobha reported Q2 FY27 total revenue of ₹1,017 Cr and PAT of ₹3.31 Cr alongside an investor presentation.
2026-10-19: Sobha's Q2FY27 press release reported record H1FY27 sales of ₹5,862 Cr (+47.2% YoY) and collections of ₹4,009 Cr, with Q2 sales of ₹2,206 Cr (+16% YoY) and H1 PAT of ₹84 Cr (-2.6% YoY).
Sobha Limited filed its statement of deviation or variation for the utilization of rights issue proceeds for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Sobha issued a final reminder-cum-forfeiture notice for the payment of first and final call money of ₹825.50 per share due between 10 November 2026 and 24 November 2026.
Sobha received a ₹29.76 Cr GST demand order from the Commissioner (Appeals) on October 23, 2026.
Sobha reported Q2FY27 concall transcript, guiding for over 50% FY27 PAT growth and planning ~11 msf of H2 launches.
